The row correctly declines to call this a book-boundary doxology -- Ps 66 is not one of the four doxology seams in psalm_device_inventory.json (41.14, 72.18-19, 89.53, 106.48) -- a precise, non-lazy register distinction. check_tiling.py over the full psalm (all 5 rows, Ps.66.1-Ps.66.20): verses_expected=20, verses_covered=20, 0 problems, GREEN. check_refs_mirror.py: clean (v5 and v15 both mirrored).

This is the exact defect class check_refs_mirror.py exists to catch (every verse argued in prose outside the row's own span must appear in boundary_evidence_refs), confirmed by the tool (flag_count: 1, argued_but_unmirrored: ['Ps.67.4']) and by direct reading of the rationale against the refs array. It does not undermine the boundary decision -- only the citation is incomplete.
